verdict.rationale: Recurly docs mention a general 'Data Imports and Exports' feature for populating accounts and keeping compliance records, and a community comment specifically praises Recurly's gateway for supporting 'credit card portability' to another provider. However, there is no vendor documentation detailing bulk export of subscriptions, invoices, or usage records, nor an official description of the payment-method portability mechanism (it's only referenced anecdotally by a user, not documented by Recurly). Missing for 10: explicit docs on invoice/usage-record export formats and scope, official documentation of stored payment-method portability/migration tooling, and any independent verification that a full data export actually contains all subscription/invoice/usage history.
